verdict.rationale: Asana's docs describe a general integration platform (App Directory, app components, webhooks/API) that lets third-party apps plug into Asana's UI and workflows, implying native integrations exist, but no evidence explicitly names Slack, GitHub, or Google Drive as supported native connectors. Missing for 10: explicit documentation or listing confirming native Slack, GitHub, and Google Drive integrations, and any hands-on/community confirmation of these specific integrations working.
